title: A scoped trial of continuous backup is approved
turns: I keep coming back to continuous backups for the Pebble Ledger database. Right now I copy the file by hand on Sunday evenings and I've forgotten twice. Litestream streams the changes to another location as they happen.
Okay, let's try it. Only on my laptop copy of the database, replicating to the spare NAS, for about a week. If the file stays consistent we can talk about the real one.
